---
title: "Home Runs"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

Teams |> select(yearID, name, G, HR)
```

```{r}
Teams |> group_by(yearID) |>
    summarise(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    team_games = sum(G), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, color = "navy") +
  labs(
    title = "Total home runs per season, with some puzzling collapses",
    subtitle = "Major League Baseball, 1871-2025",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Teams table"
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
            team_games = sum(G),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(hr_per_game = HR / team_games) |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020))
```

```{r}
Teams |> group_by(yearID) |> summarize(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
team_games = sum(G),
.groups = "drop") |> 
        mutate(hr_per_game = HR / team_games) |>
ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
geom_line(color = "grey60") +
geom_point(size = 0.7, color = "navy") +
labs(title = "Home runs per game reveal baseball's real eras", 
    subtitle = "MLB home runs per team per game, 1871-2025",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Teams table"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
Teams |> group_by(yearID) |> summarize(HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
team_games = sum(G),
.groups = "drop") |> mutate(hr_per_game = HR / team_games, shortened = yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)) |> ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) + geom_line(color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = shortened), size = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "navy", `TRUE` = "red"),
    labels = c("Full season", "Shortened season"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home runs per game reveal baseball's real eras",
    subtitle = "MLB home runs per team per game, 1871-2025",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Teams table"
  )
```
